column6: Listen and order the sentences from 1-5.
I hope it's not too serious.
I have a stomachache, my head hurts, and I have a sore throat.
You've got a fever; your temperature is 103.
If you want to recover soon, get plenty of rest, take your medicine,
When you have a stomachache, fever, chills, and a sore throat, you
have something more serious than a common cold.
